name: Pack
overview: Kristina, a successful travel blogger, along with her boyfriend and cameraman Dania, go to film a crime scene in provincial Volchegorsk. Their goal is to find dirt on the current mayor in order to help his competitor take the post of mayor. However, upon arrival, the expected routine turns into a nightmare: Danya disappears without a trace, and Kristina is attacked by a local "Pack" — aggressive dogs that keep the whole city at bay.
